scientific_object: Whether the released, non-cloned Skill-SP taxonomy already allocates different package-sampling eligibility mass to otherwise ordinary benchmark tasks solely because some tasks lie in overlapping skill support, and whether the released textual duplicate filter detects those support overlaps.

frozen_definitions.eligibility_exposure_mass: For a benchmark task t, sum the author sampler's normalized package probability p(s) over every released skill s whose released validator accepts t. This is control-plane eligibility mass, not the realized probability that the question generator emits t.
frozen_definitions.duplicate_filter: author skill_library.library.jaccard_similarity on name+description with threshold 0.33
